datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Kenya to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for 2020, capturing projected food insecurity scenarios at the sub-national level.
